summary:
**Market Summary: Session of 2026-10-28**

U.S. broad indexes closed mostly higher. SPY rose 0.19% to 771.15, DIA gained 0.21%, and QQQ added 0.11%, while IWM slipped 0.07%. Energy led the sectors, with XLE up 1.03% and USO up 3.31%. Technology (XLK, +0.35%) and financials (XLF, +0.47%) also advanced. Communication services (XLC, -0.47%) and real estate (XLRE, -1.00%) lagged. Gold (GLD) fell 0.57%, long Treasuries (TLT) dropped 0.53%, and the dollar (UUP) was roughly flat. Among eligible stocks, GMAB (+29.3%), AXGN (+28.5%) and KIDS (+23.7%) led gainers, while BCAX (-46.0%) led decliners. Headlines centered on Vertiv, whose orders more than doubled and whose shares rose 14%, on Robinhood's quarterly results, and on the Federal Reserve meeting, where markets priced in less than a 10% chance of another hike. Israeli bonds and the shekel fell after an inconclusive election.
